name: Beanbid
summary: A coral-and-black trading desk that sells green coffee lots by live auction
about: Beanbid is the sales desk of a made-up green-coffee importer. Lots go live on the floor, roasters bid in real time, countdown rings tick down and late bids extend the clock. Sold lots become contracts and shipments you can follow to the roaster, with analytics on price against cup score.
how: Open Live auctions and watch bids arrive in the feed and on each card
Extend an auction, change its reserve or accept the leading bid early
Send a lot from the warehouse to the floor with an opening price and a reserve
Follow sold lots as ships cross from the origin port to the roaster
Mark contracts paid or send a reminder
Hover the dots on Analytics to see what each lot sold for against its cup score
